findings.issue: Docstrings still tell users the converse is not available in the repository, which this PR makes false. BaseChange.lean:54-58 ("needs the *uniqueness* half of Artin-Wedderburn ... not yet available in the repository, so it is not claimed here"), BaseChange.lean:189-192 ("The converse needs the uniqueness half of Artin-Wedderburn"), and Group.lean:219-222 (`mk_eq_one_of_isSplittingField`: "The converse is not available here: it needs the uniqueness of the division algebra in a Brauer class"). Group.lean:85 additionally states the kernel identification "is not proved anywhere yet".

summary: The new splitting API is well-formed and correctly annotated, but it makes the roadmap's actual Layer 6 product — the kernel of base change is exactly the classes split by `L` — a two-line corollary that the PR does not add, and it leaves three docstrings asserting that this converse is unavailable in the repository.
